title: P.A. Inamdar v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: P.A. Inamdar v. State of Maharashtra, (2005) 6 SCC 537
content.holding: The seven-judge Bench considered State regulation and compulsory seat-sharing/reservation in private unaided professional institutions and reaffirmed the need to preserve institutional autonomy within the constitutional framework.
content.relevance: Core authority on admissions, unaided professional institutions and Article 30 regulation.

evidence.note: 7-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Civil Appeal No. 5041 of 2005; 2005 INSC 388; (2005) 6 SCC 537; 2005 Supp (2) SCR 603.
